content.name: Vardath - Kopis Production Cheat
content.description: Standalone superfast Kopis mobile resource factory and station build-storage feeder. Huge 3-way cargo and drone/crew capacities, fixed custom 100x laser physically bound to primary gun connection with no functional turret socket. Maintains one player-owned Yaki-crewed Astrid, automatically replacing it near the player when lost or sold. Adds Astrid Tours: separate Yaki-crewed cheat yacht with 3x nominal speed, stronger handling, scoped 3-second stop target and 1000x dedicated weapon/turret damage.
content.author: Vardath
